name: Youth Committee Bi-Monthly Meeting
agenda_text:
YOUTH COMMITTEE
  MEETING AGENDA
  Thursday, September 24, 2026, 5:30 p.m.

  Council Chambers (5938 Kauffman Avenue)

PUBLIC COMMENT PROCEDURES
Public comments will be taken in the order received.

•  Each speaker will be limited to 3 minutes unless otherwise determined by the Chair.

You could address the Youth Committee at the following times:
 • Agenda item: at the time the Committee considers the agenda item;
 • Non-agenda item: at the time for PUBLIC COMMENTS. Please note that while the
  Committee values your comments, pursuant to the Brown Act, the Committee cannot
  take action on any item not listed on the agenda.

The listing of any item on the agenda includes the authority of the Committee to
take action on such item and to approve, disapprove, or give directions on any item

SUBMISSION OF WRITTEN COMMENTS
Written comments may be submitted in advance to cityclerk@templecityca.gov 24 hours
prior to the meeting. Written comments will be distributed to the Committee but will not
be read aloud by staff or the Committee.

  6. CONSENT CALENDAR

  7. NEW BUSINESS

  A.  PROPOSED YOUTH COMMITTEE MEETING DATES FOR FISCAL YEAR
  2025-26

  The proposed Youth Committee meeting dates identify dates for Fiscal Year
  (FY) 2026-27 to allow Youth Committee, the public and staff to adequately
  plan and schedule agenda items for future meetings.

  Presentation:  Deputy City Clerk

  Recommendation:  Approve or revise proposed Youth Committee
  meeting dates for FY 2026-27.

  B.  LIGHTS ON! TEMPLE CITY SUB-COMMITTEE APPOINTMENT

  The Youth Committee is requested to appoint five members to serve on
  Lights On! Temple City Subcommittee and to discuss the objectives to
  promote at the event.

  Presentation:  Deputy City Clerk

  Recommendation:  Appoint five committee members to the Lights
  On! Temple City Subcommittee to assist staff
  with planning and coordinating the committee’s
  participation in the event and to discuss the
  objectives to promote at the event.
